title: Totem Wars
description: An Public Event / SMP Plugin. It can help in minecraft videos as well
body:
Totem Wars (Enhanced) is a Paper 1.21.1 Minecraft PvP event plugin where a Totem of Power spawns at random locations on the map.

Players compete to find it, and once someone picks it up, their coordinates are broadcast to all players and shown on everyone’s screen. The holder must survive for 5 minutes without dying to win a powerful random reward like OP enchanted gear or special items.

It’s designed to create intense server-wide PvP fights focused around one high-value objective.
